name: hud_ui_mp_exit_dialog_load_layout
description: HudUiMpExitDialog::LoadLayout captures and blurs the primary surface, loads and binds MPEXIT layout widgets, and configures either the new-game button or multiplayer exit messages.
known_limits: same-session VC5SP3 verification for 0x419500 passes with zero unmasked byte mismatches after COFF relocation masking.
The former RefreshState slot blocker is resolved by modeling HudUiWidget center-position accessors in the inherited virtual slots, putting HudUiZrdWidget::RefreshState at retail slot 0x78.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x419500 validates the capture/blur sequence, dialog.zrd:MPEXIT load, conditional MPNEWGAME binding, MPEXITBTN binding, SetChildFlags(0), new-game RefreshState path, network message path, fade reset, and SetEnabled(1).
Native smoke hud_ui_mp_exit_dialog_load_layout_smoke patches heavy dependencies and verifies both the new-game-enabled path and the no-new-game network message path.
